html:
Greetings, Agents. 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight. 

 

The story of the invasion of the demonic horde led by the Goblin Queen
and the X-Men members trying to stop it begins!
Will this world in turmoil be able to regain peace?

 

We introduce the January Update 
in celebration of the addition of the Goblin Queen theme. 

 

Cyclops, who has endured many battles with his Blast ability, has received Tier-4 Advancement.
Havok, a Super Hero who releases Plasma with his entire body, and Madelyne Pryor,
the hatred-filled Goblin Queen, have been newly added with the powers of Tier-3. 

 

Also, Exodus, who gains strength from the trust of those around him, 
and Hope Summers, who can absorb and use the abilities of all Mutants, 
have newly joined the world of MARVEL Future Fight!

 

Explore the stories of the new Super Heroes through the addition of a new Epic Quest,
and check out the various improvements, 
including new items related to Urus, that will help with hero growth!
 

 

▣ Four New Heroes

 

Check out the abilities of Havok <Modern>, who can release powerful Plasma Blasts, 
Exodus <Modern>, a Psionic expert motivated by his own sense of justice and duty,
Hope Summers <Modern>, who possesses the ability to mimic and use the powers of all Mutants, 
and Madelyne Pryor <Goblin Queen>, a formidable Psychic with telepathy and telekinesis abilities. 
* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ One New Uniform


A new Uniform has been added
in celebration of the Goblin Queen themed update.
Check out the abilities of Rachel Summers <X-Men: Days of Future Past>.
* The new Uniform skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.
* The new Uniform will be on sale for 40% off during the <January Update Celebration Event>,
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.  

 

 

 

▣ Cyclops Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Cyclops.
Check out the skills that have made the powerful blast user even stronger. 
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats. 

 

 

 

▣ Havok, Madelyn Pryor Tier-3

 

Check out the Tier-3 Ultimate Skills that amplify
the blast ability of Havok and the psionic ability of Madelyn Pryor!

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Rachel Summers, Hope Summers, and Kid Omega
Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the January Update, Rachel Summers, Hope Summers, 
and Kid Omega will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!
* The skill effects are based on lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Epic Quest Goblin Queen

 

We introduce you to <Goblin Queen>,
the new Epic Quest theme added through the January Update. 

 

1. Follow the journey of Native Tier-2 hero, Havok, and watch him grow!

 

- Havok is a Native Tier-2 hero and can only be upgraded through the Epic Quest.
- Havok’s Tier-2 Passive will apply immediately upon acquisition. 
- Havok can upgrade levels through the Epic Quest Progression Rewards
without a separate Potential Search and Enhancement. 

 

2. Native Tier-2 hero Madelyne Pryor can be acquired 
when meeting the hero possession/development requirement in the Goblin Queen menu. 

 

- Madelyne Pryor will be available for acquisition when upgrading 
all the required heroes on the bottom of the screen to Tier-2 level 60. 
- As Madelyne Pryor is a Native Tier-2 hero, Phoenix Feathers and M’krran Crystals are used for upgrades. 

 

3. Special Rewards and exclusive stage benefits will be available
through the Epic Quest - Deluxe Pack or the Special Deluxe Pack. 

 

[Deluxe Pack] 
Benefits will be available after purchasing with Crystals.

 

[Special Deluxe Pack] 
Deluxe benefits + 1,000 Crystals and 2,500 VIP points
will be acquired immediately upon in-app purchase. 


[Epic Quest: Goblin Queen Deluxe Pack Benefits]
1. Story Completion Reward - Deluxe additional rewards available
2. Acquire 6★ Hope Summers instantly
3. Unlock Sinister Schemes mission instantly

 

* The two packages, Epic Quest: Goblin Queen - Deluxe and Epic Quest: Goblin Queen - Special Deluxe
cannot be purchased simultaneously, and can only be purchased once per account. 
* The Epic Quest: Goblin Queen - Deluxe benefits will apply immediately 
upon purchase, and Crystal refunds may be unavailable after purchase.
* The Epic Quest: Goblin Queen - Special Deluxe effects will apply immediately upon opening
the product at the Inbox, and withdrawal of the subscription may be restricted after purchase. 
* The Special stage available after purchasing the two Deluxe packages
will be available even after the Epic Quest is completed.
* The Epic Quest: Goblin Queen - Special Deluxe purchase price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

4. Special items can be acquired through the Epic Quest Collection <X-Mansion Secret Base>.
Collection materials can be acquired at a fixed probability when clearing each stage. 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Item Odin’s Blessing and Enchanted Uru Amplifier

 

1. Five new [Odin’s Blessing] items have been added.
The following items can be acquired through Uru combination or 
at the Store - Dimension Chest - Enchanted Uru Chest. 
* The five new Odin’s Blessings will be available after the 1/16 Maintenance.
* The five new Odin’s Blessings will not be available from the
Selector: Odin’s Blessing and Odin’s Blessing Chest acquired from previous game modes/event rewards.

 

 

2. The [Enchanted Uru Amplifier] item has been newly added. 
When using the Enchanted Uru Amplifier, 
five Enchanted Uru slots of the selected gear will all be Amplified.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Havok, Exodus, Hope Summers, Madelyne Pryor, 
Rachel Summers, and Kid Omega will be added after the January Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats. 

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update. 

 

[Future Pass Rewards] 

 - Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 

Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

New Special Icons that will represent you have been added. 
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, 
and two more from the upcoming Event!

 

[January Update New Special Icon] 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The maximum storage quantity of X-Men hero growth materials at the Inventory has been increased.
The items and quantities being increased are of the following: 


[Target Items]
- M’kraan Shard
- Phoenix Feather
- M’kraan Crystal


[Quantity]
Before: 6,000 
After: 9,000 

 

2. The four Contribution Reward heroes will now be available at the Store consistently.  
- Target Heroes: Rachel Summers, Negasonic Teenage Warhead, Professor X, Abomination


3. Timeline Battle game mode has been improved.
▶ The Auto Repeat ending pop-up screen has been improved 
to display the win/defeat information and acquired rewards.  

 

 

▶ A new setting to enable or disable Auto-Repeat when Timeline Battle rewards cannot be 
claimed anymore has been added to the Arena category at the Menu - Settings - Option tab. 

 

 

4. The purchase method of Battle Pass Levels of Future Pass and Otherworld Battle has been improved. 
You can now level up to the desired level instantly by tapping the Level Up button at the main screen. 

 

 

5. The Uniform Store’s filtering feature has been improved 
to make it easier to find the Uniform you desire. 
- A new filter has been added to search for Uniforms by selecting Elements and Abilities.
- The location of the existing search menu has been changed
to include the Owned / Unowned / Favorite filters.
- A 'Gender' filter has been added to the All Elements filter. 

 

 

6. Hero growth items including Rank Up Tickets, Type Enhance Tickets, 
and more have been changed to be available to sell. 
- 3★ - 4★ Mega Rank Up Tickets, 2★ - 6★ Mega Mastery Tickets, 

Mega Uniform Update Tickets: Rare, Heroic
- Stage 1 - 4 Premium Type Enhance Tickets, Stage 1 - 6 Type Enhance Tickets, 

Stage 2 - 4 Advanced Type Enhance Tickets
- Potential Realization Tickets, and more 

 

 

7. The Upgrade notification pop-up screen has been improved not to be displayed
when upgrading a Collection Option at Team-Up Collection. 


8. After purchasing an item from the Battlefield Shop at Otherworld Battle,
the animation has been improved not to be displayed when tapping the deactivated button.


9. The Skill Name Glossary information has been updated. 
- Details regarding the skill effect Loss has been added. 


10. When using the Tier-4 Striker skill, the targeting of 
the enemy changing when the Striker appears has been improved. 


11. The modeling of Ultron in Nick Fury’s Tier-3 Advancement animation has been changed.


12. Items acquired, beyond the maximum limit, as rewards have been improved
to be sent to the Inbox when progressing through Epic Quest stages.
- ‘Phoenix Feathers’ will be distributed as alternative rewards when acquiring
hero upgrade rewards of Epic Quest Native level heroes that have already been upgraded.


13. The Character Overview information has been improved. 
- When changing the Hero Info screen to Character Overview mode, 
it has been improved to display the 'Uniform Effects.'
- When tapping the magnifying glass icon at the battle preparation screen for each game mode,
it has been improved to display the 'Uniform Effects' 

and 'Abilities' information at the Character Overview pop-up screen. 

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The playable hero modeling in Chapter 1 of Legendary Battle
<Marvel Studios’ Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania> being darkly displayed has been fixed. 


2. The appearance of Spider-Gwen <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse> 
not displaying correctly when purchased through a specific route has been fixed. 


3. The details of the ‘Ash’ ability in the 5th Active Skill of 
Iron Man <Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Endgame> and <Team Suit>
changing when reaching Level 10 have been improved.


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned. 


Thank you.
